intuition: A partition can end only after the final occurrence of every character seen so far.

brute_force.approach: Try every cut and verify that no character appears on both sides.

optimal.approach: Precompute each character's last index and close a partition when the scan reaches the current farthest last occurrence.

edge_cases: A character occurring only once can form a one-character partition.
If every character repeats across the string, the result may be one partition.
